summary: The unvault lookup takes a single required argument, _terms, which is the path or list of paths of files to read.
questions: What arguments does the unvault lookup need?
Can I pass several file paths to lookup('unvault') at once?
Is the file path mandatory for the unvault lookup?

answer_card.title: unvault lookup parameters
answer_card.answer_md: The only parameter is `_terms` (required): one or more paths of files to read, e.g. `lookup('ansible.builtin.unvault', '/etc/a.txt', '/etc/b.txt')`.
